title: Successor and Predecessor of Fixed-Width Digits
statement: Let $w,n$ be natural numbers with $n+1<2^w$. The fixed-width little-endian binary increment of the $w$-digit representation of $n$ is the representation of $n+1$, and the fixed-width decrement of that representation is the representation of $n$.
